terminal_oxygen_source_audit.method: Gemmi parses the published source_structure; sequence_context maps physical residue ordinals to deposited author identities and complete sequence positions
terminal_oxygen_source_audit.limitation: A confirmed deposited sequence end is not by itself a validated repair, protonation state or chemical cap. Missing side-chain identities in log messages are truncated to eight examples.

interpretation_limits: The 49 potential coverage failures do not establish a failure or success of their LJ fields: the old producer stopped before their independent LJ audits.
The seven allocation guard failures are preventive refusals, not observed operating-system out-of-memory failures.
Masking unsupported chemistry retains benchmark membership but does not establish adequate VF training coverage.
Repairing only confirmed terminal oxygens is a candidate new preparation protocol; it was not enabled or scientifically validated by this read-only audit.
